title: Nonconvex Composite Functional Constraints via First-Order Augmented Lagrangian Methods under Local Regularity
abstract: arXiv:2607.08954v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study nonasymptotic convergence of primal-dual methods for a class of nonconvex constrained optimization problems under local multiplier regularity. Both the objective and functional inequality constraints are compositions of convex Lipschitz outer functions with smooth nonlinear mappings. Unlike existing analyses requiring regularity globally or along the entire iterate sequence, we impose multiplier regularity only near the feasible set. Using an auxiliary minimax problem with a compact dual set, we derive Lyapunov estimates that identify nearly feasible iterates under feasible initialization and a sufficiently large penalty, without assuming multiplier boundedness. Local regularity then bounds the associated multipliers and makes dual truncation inactive, yielding approximate KKT certificates for the original problem. The smoothed prox-linear augmented Lagrangian method with dual regularization yields an $O(K^{-1/3})$ KKT

translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类非凸约束优化问题在局部乘子正则性条件下的原始-对偶方法的非渐近收敛性。目标函数和泛函不等式约束均为凸Lipschitz外函数与光滑非线性映射的复合。与现有分析要求正则性全局成立或沿整个迭代序列成立不同，我们仅在可行集附近施加乘子正则性。利用具有紧对偶集的辅助极小极大问题，我们推导出Lyapunov估计，在可行初始化和足够大的罚参数下识别出近似可行的迭代点，而无需假设乘子有界。随后，局部正则性给出了相应乘子的界并使对偶截断失效，从而为原问题提供近似的KKT证书。带对偶正则化的光滑近端线性增广拉格朗日方法获得了 $O(K^{-1/3})$ 的KKT
tldr: 该论文在仅需可行集附近局部乘子正则性的弱条件下，无需假设乘子有界，通过带对偶正则化的光滑近端线性增广拉格朗日原始-对偶方法，为非凸复合约束优化问题建立了非渐近KKT收敛保证，达到 $O(K^{-1/3})$ 的KKT误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes nonasymptotic KKT convergence guarantees with an $O(K^{-1/3})$ error rate for nonconvex composite constrained optimization via smoothed prox-linear augmented Lagrangian primal-dual methods, requiring only local multiplier regularity near the feasible set without assuming multiplier boundedness.
